references.text: Refers to the same law that Moses presented to the children of Israel
Moses commands that the law be written clearly; the same Hebrew root 'באר' (to explain/make clear) is used
Reference to the area on the other side of the Jordan, in the land of Moab
The children of Israel camped on the plains of Moab by the Jordan, the same geographical context
Same geographical location: on the other side of the Jordan, in the valley opposite Beth-Peor in the land of Moab
Moses wrote down this law and gave it to the priests, the sons of Levi
The prophet Habakkuk is told to write the vision clearly; the same Hebrew root 'באר' is used
